done_when: After a reload on an item's Plan tab, the Plan tab is still open, and a link to the Plan tab opens it.
why: On an item page, a reload, Back or Forward returns the reader to the Overview tab, and no link can open the Plan tab. Escape on a full item page sends the reader to the Now screen instead of doing nothing, and after a reload Escape on the drawer leaves keyboard focus at the top of the page instead of on the card it came from.
